_what: Words the one markdown renderer (document-page-html.mjs markdownHtml, with `marks: true`) draws as marks inside plain words: each row is a mark, `pattern` the words it takes (a Unicode regular expression, matched only at the start of the words or after a space or punctuation that is not part of a word or address), and `link` true when the words are an address that opens. A mark is drawn as `<span class="doc-mark" data-mark="<id>">` (or a link with that class), so its look lives in the stylesheet beside the reading surface (screen-look file-preview.css). Adding a kind of mark is a row here.
